A later focused no-model regression verifies that corrected filtering preserves the transcript and both topics; no replacement real call was made.

turns.assessment: Correctly identifies Contacts editing, group creation and unverified recurring tasks across three supplied sources. Clear but incomplete workflow prose.
turns.limitations: Contacts navigation omits Resources → Contacts and Save Changes; group instructions omit the final Create group confirmation. Complete verified source paths/guidance are still supplied. The inference prompt was clarified afterward; no claim of a new real evaluation of that prompt.

turns.assessment: Model accuracy failure: phrasing claims someone can be added to an existing personal DM through creating a new group, contradicting the partial capability contract. Corrected guard rejects this unchanged raw response and returns the verified direct-guide fallback.
turns.limitations: The initial accepted AI answer, unchanged raw model response, and explicit post-capture rejection/fallback are retained. Existing Jobs/Proposals preservation was correctly stated, but the invalid DM claim makes the combined generated answer unacceptable.

conclusion: Four bounded real requests yielded two useful but imperfect generated answers, one provider failure, and one inaccurate generated answer now rejected. Multi-turn real-model quality remains incompletely validated. All 20 existing local reservations are consumed; no cap bypass or additional call was made.
